verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS support platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk data export, no open-format download such as CSV or JSON dumps, and no offboarding or data-portability feature. The general API (pylon-docs-31) and MCP read access (pylon-docs-34) are developer building blocks that could be used to build an export, not the export capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
